specs.快门: Electronic vertical running metal focal plane shutter.
specs.快门速度: Quartz-timed electronic shutter with variable speeds on AUTO from 1/1000 to 1 seconds. Manual from 1/1000 to 1 sec., plus X (1/100 sec.) and "B" Sync speed of 1/100 sec.
specs.曝光测光: TTL, center-weighted at full aperture. Aperture-preferred automatic exposure.
specs.取景器: Fixed eye-level pentaprism type; field of view 95%; 0.86 magnification (with 50 mm lens)
specs.对焦: Horizontal split-image spot, with microprism collar and matte field.
specs.胶片/画幅: With rapid advance lever; 130° setting angle; 20° standoff position.
